name: Prawn Balchão
instructions: 1. Grind red chilies and spices with vinegar. 2. Sauté onions until caramelized. 3. Add spice paste and cook until oil separates. 4. Toss in prawns and simmer until done.
description: A fiery Portuguese-inspired pickle, preserving the soul of the sea in vinegar and spice.
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
